_comment: Shared skill taxonomy. Add new skills here as repos require them — do not hardcode skills in Python files. Any team member can extend this list.
_updated_by_member_2: Replaced the old generic list (Machine Learning, REST API, database...) with scoring.skill_matching.SKILL_TAXONOMY's real, validated tags, so the LLM extraction prompt and the actual ranking/skill-match scoring agree on what a 'skill' is. The old list never overlapped with what skill_matching.py used (only 'documentation' was shared), so skill-match scores and the sidebar's overlap badge were structurally disconnected from each other. Validated hit rates across the 4 pilot repos (validate_taxonomy.py): matplotlib 87.5%, pandas 93.2%, datasets 82.8%, networkx 69.1% issues matched at least one tag.
_note_on_extensibility: When a repository needs skills not in core_skills, the extraction prompt is allowed to propose new ones under a separate 'proposed_skills' field rather than forcing a bad fit into the fixed list. A human (any team member) reviews proposed_skills periodically and promotes good ones into core_skills. If you add or rename a tag here, also add it to scoring/skill_matching.SKILL_TAXONOMY with matching keywords, or the two will drift apart again.
